mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening economy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate activity, measured by a rise in housing starts by more than 5% in two months, signals a strengthening economy and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production by more than 2% in two months signals a supply-side contraction, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 in a month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances with strong payroll growth.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% in a month and CPI (CPIAUCSL) remains stable (less than 0.2% increase), it indicates strong demand without significant inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% in 1 month and CPIAUCSL increases < 0.2%
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% year-over-year, it signals a restrictive monetary policy combined with weak economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 3% year-over-year, combined with a stable or decreasing unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals strong economic growth and labor market health, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY growth > 3% and UNRATE stable or decreasing
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.
